query: One reason why these dynamic patterns are not usually considered is that they have to be described by complex, high-dimensional models; and it is unclear how best to use these models for prediction.

query: The parcellation was estimated from the data using multi-session spatial ICA on the temporally concatenated data from all subjects. query: We evaluated the robustness by iterating nested 10-fold CV 100 times for each variable, randomising the subjects in the folds at each iteration, so that the models would encounter a different combination of subjects in the training and test sets each time they are run.
